services.desc: A scenic rest stop or picnic area with views of the copper-coloured Blackstone River. This day use area is the perfect place to rest, stretch your legs, and enjoy the wilderness, as you drive the Liard Trail. Nearby attractionsA staggering 30,000 square kilometres, Nahanni National Park Reserve is a designated UNESCO World Heritage Site where unlimited adventures await. Safety informationFor general information about safety resources while in the Northwest Territories, check our Safety resources page.
